scientific_question: At the same twelve fitted parameters and 13A+1A-transpose non-anchor budget as v164.1, does enforcing the density continuity equation rather than passive-scalar pullback repair the two late five-camera gradient tails?
role: result-blind, post-open controlled virtual-BOST mechanism diagnostic frozen after the independently validated v165 failure; no v166 scientific array may be read before this protocol and its complete formal/independent implementation closure are committed
physical_hypothesis: The first model channel is density, so an invertible coordinate flow should conserve mass. The correct infinitesimal action is -div(rho*u), and the exact transported density is the inverse-mapped previous density multiplied by the inverse-map Jacobian determinant. Passive-scalar affine and cross-term warps omitted this compressibility term.

representation.field_subspace: zero-mean orthonormal DCT 16x8x8 excluding the constant coefficient
representation.initial_anchor: at t=0 use the frozen isotropic H1 fixed-0.03 reconstruction because no previous deployed state exists
representation.affine_generator: u(x)=h_min*(v+M*s(x)), where s maps each world axis affinely to [-1,1], v has three entries, M has nine row-major entries, and h_min is the minimum field-grid spacing
representation.continuity_tangents: for each generator b_k, form -div(rho_previous*b_k)=-b_k dot grad(rho_previous)-rho_previous*div(b_k); translation divergence is zero and only the three matching output/input linear entries have nonzero constant divergence
representation.observation_fit: project the twelve continuity tangents through the current reported-geometry operator and solve the current observation innovation by column-normalized minimum-norm SVD
representation.exact_transport: scale the fitted generator only when necessary, exponentiate its centered homogeneous matrix, inverse-map the current grid with trilinear zero-outside sampling, then multiply by 1/det(A) where A is the exact forward affine linear block
representation.mass_conservation_identity: rho_current(x)=rho_previous(A_inverse*(x-b))/det(A); the density factor is positive finite and its product with det(A) equals one within numerical tolerance
representation.zero_mean_projection: after exact mass-conserving transport, remove the field mean only because the frozen reconstruction subspace excludes the constant DCT coefficient
representation.maximum_corner_displacement: h_min*(t_i-t_(i-1))/0.25; one minimum-grid cell per reference time step
representation.trust_region_scaling: if exact exponentiated corner displacement exceeds the cap, use 60-step monotone bisection on one scalar in [0,1]; no component clipping or refit
representation.current_solve: project the mass-conserving transported prior into the same DCT subspace and solve (G+alpha*H)c=q+alpha*H*c_transport with frozen isotropic H1 and alpha=0.03*median_positive_generalized_eigenvalue
representation.no_transport_control: the same causal centered-H1 recurrence using the previous control coefficients directly, with no affine fit or warp
representation.previous_state: the immediately previous reconstruction of the same arm, model, calibration, and active-camera set; never truth or a separately selected candidate
representation.permutation_contract: camera-row reordering leaves G, q, fitted affine parameters, mass-conserving transported prior, and reconstructed coefficients unchanged within frozen tolerances
representation.variable_cardinality: the same mechanism is rebuilt independently for fixed 5-, 7-, and 9-camera active sets
representation.forbidden_variants: no passive-scalar fallback, alternative determinant power, absolute determinant, clipping, future frame, bidirectional smoothing, truth state, reset, generator component clipping, alternative cap, alternative SVD cutoff, non-affine mode, learned transition, alternative anchor, per-sample selector, or post-result multiplier

decision_order: Any input-root, parent-evidence, source-semantics, operator, basis, sequence, density, affine-rank, continuity-tangent, linearized-fit, determinant-factor, diffeomorphism, cap, stationarity, residual, accounting, current-control, permutation, or independent-recomputation failure makes v166 inconclusive.

Only the frozen twelve-generator observation-fitted mass-conserving affine transport with reciprocal determinant density factor, fixed cap, SVD cutoff, interpolation, H1 multiplier 0.03, and causal recurrence is primary; no alternative determinant power, mode, radius, or multiplier may replace it after results.

The primary passes only if all twelve time-by-camera strata pass every absolute gate, every nine-camera stratum satisfies parent no-harm, and t=0.75 five-camera gradient p90 is strictly below the frozen current-run H1 value.
If the no-transport centered-H1 control also passes all twelve strata, continuity transport is not credited and a predictor is not authorized from this diagnostic alone.

A valid primary failure closes only mass-conserving global affine transport; it does not prove all continuity-based local flow impossible and does not authorize determinant tuning, a larger network, or GPU rescue.

A valid primary pass with no-transport-control failure establishes only controlled virtual-BOST continuity-transport headroom and authorizes a separately frozen minimal CPU observation-only predictor diagnostic; it is not real BOST, external generalization, or a resource result.
